errors.description: The agent repeatedly attempted to use the web_search tool with highly specific queries that returned no results, resulting in an exception indicating that the searched resource was not found. This prevented the agent from obtaining the necessary information to answer the task.

The agent produced a final answer that was not directly supported by any retrieved evidence or verification from the searched content. The answer essentially hallucinated the specific command (Replace All with a regex) that was supposedly used in the video, without confirming it against the blog post or video transcript.
